name: Grilled muong fish
summary: A finger-sized fish with soft, fragrant, sweet flesh. It is grilled over charcoal, then dipped briefly in vinegar so the bones soften.
origin: Phu Yen. The kitchens are at bàu Long Thăng in La Hai and at cầu Lò Gốm in An Thạch.
texture: Soft, fragrant, and sweet, and small enough that a quick vinegar dip softens the bones.
howToEat: Eat the grilled fish with herbs and nước mắm nhỉ mixed with a little tamarind or peanut. It also comes as gỏi, nhúng dấm, luộc, or chiên xù, but the grill is the usual plate.
where: Beside bàu Long Thăng in thị trấn La Hai, huyện Đồng Xuân, and at cầu Lò Gốm in xã An Thạch, huyện Tuy An.
seoTitle: Ca muong — grilled, then dipped in vinegar
seoDescription: Finger-sized fish grilled over charcoal and dipped in vinegar, at La Hai and cau Lo Gom.
